criteria.criterion: Find and open Google's official Gemini API documentation page (official Google domain)
criteria.final_justification: Baseline assumed an uncontrollable CAPTCHA blocker and gave full credit, but the visual evidence does not confirm any blocker and does not show the agent opening an official Gemini API documentation page. With no confirmed blocker and no successful opening of official docs, this criterion is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Report the page title of the official Gemini API documentation page
criteria.final_justification: Because the official documentation page was not opened in the captured evidence, the page title cannot be recorded. Also, the claimed CAPTCHA blocker is not visually confirmed, so full-credit-for-blocker is not warranted.

criteria.criterion: Report the domain of the documentation source
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not open or display an official Gemini API documentation source, so the documentation domain was not identified from an opened doc page (or even from visible results). With no confirmed blocker screenshot, cannot award full credit on blocker grounds.

criteria.criterion: Identify the Python SDK shown in the documentation's Python example
criteria.final_justification: Without opening the official documentation page, the agent could not have extracted the Python SDK used in the official example. The predicted output does not provide an SDK either, and the claimed blocker is not visually corroborated.

criteria.criterion: Identify the model used in the Python example on that documentation page
criteria.final_justification: The model used in the documentation’s Python example was not retrieved or reported. No confirmed uncontrollable blocker in screenshots to justify full credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no API key creation, no code execution; stop after recording required fields)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints (no sign-in, no API key creation, no code execution) appear respected. However, the agent’s stopping condition was not achieved (did not open official docs and record required fields). Still, this criterion primarily measures constraint compliance, which is satisfied.
